items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill TEMPORARY positions with SCCCD. Are you available for a temporary position at this time? Options: Yes | No

02. PLEASE NOTE: Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

03. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess in business or public administration, management information systems or a closely related field: Please attach a copy of your degree or transcripts showing when degree was awarded or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree | Associate's degree or higher | Bachelor's degree of higher | Master's degree or higher

04. (MQ) Please select the level of increasingly responsible technical and analytical professional experience involving business systems analysis and applications development you possess: Options: Less than one (1) year of experience. | One (1) to less than three (3) years of experience. | Three (3) to less than five (5) years of experience. | Five (5) to less than seven (7) years of experience. | Seven (7) or more years of experience.

05. (MR) Do you possess experience in a college setting or in a public agency? Please describe experience below. This information will also need to be identifiable in the work history portion of the application or the application may be deemed incomplete.

06. (MR) Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program. Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
